description: The state of a template import (queued, working, retrying, done, failed). Retrying: an attempt failed for a reason outside the picture and the queue will try again. Failed is final and shows its stage and error in words to relay. When done, template_row_id is the saved template: it is in stills_templates_list.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_template_import_get
title: Read a stills template import
